tools.name: list_yachts
tools.description: Search the published crewed-yacht catalog by starting budget, capacity, activity or travel style. Read the returned pricing and availability caveats.

maxRate.description: Maximum starting weekly rate in USD; not a guest-specific quote

activity.description: Activity tag, e.g. snorkeling, e-foiling or sea-scooters

bestFor.description: Travel-style tag, e.g. families, couples or food

tools.name: get_yacht
tools.description: Read a yacht's published details and pricing caveats by catalog ID. This does not confirm availability.

tools.name: check_dream_on_availability
tools.description: Read Dream On's official unavailable-date calendar with 48-hour turnaround buffers. This does not book or hold dates; refer guests to dreamonsail.com.
